description: Architectural service for property abroad received by an Irish business (s.34(c) exception to the general B2B rule)
notes: VATCA 2010 s.34(a) excepts supplies connected with immovable goods from the general B2B rule: the place of supply is where the goods are located (s.34(c)). The general rule still names the exception rather than deciding the place itself, and the line stays under review: where the property is, and the establishment tests, are multi-factor questions (EU Reg 282/2011 arts.10-11).
